dialogue.speaker: orange
dialogue.text: I'm overreacting? I didn't even say anything!

dialogue.speaker: purple
dialogue.text: I just don't think you should call me lazy.

dialogue.speaker: orange
dialogue.text: Call you lazy? I made a joke! It's really not fair how you make a big deal out of everything. You make me out to be a terrible blobfriend over nothing.

dialogue.speaker: purple
dialogue.text: I'm sorry… I didn't mean to make you feel like that. I know you were just teasing.

dialogue.speaker: orange
dialogue.text: I'm sorry too. I wouldn't have joked about it if I knew how important this was to you.

glossary.label: What is DARVO?
glossary.body: DARVO (Deny, Attack, Reverse Victim & Offender) is a manipulation tactic where an abuser denies their behavior, attacks the person confronting them, and flips the narrative to make themselves look like the actual victim.
